topic: Field equipment recast and toolbar removal
currentUserGoal: Replace the run toolbar and Sensi advisor with a field-equipment window that shows unlocked helpers, owned counts, and current-run RT purchases, while restoring varied grass tiles and lively equipment feedback.
workCompleted: Removed the visible run toolbar and keyboard tool controls from the active redesign layout.
Removed the Sensi Advisor panel from the active run layout.
Added a responsive Field Equipment window beside the field, with a desktop single-column rail and compact phone grid.
Added seven inherited helper types: Tiny Sprinkler, Field Mouse, Bee Hive, Earthworm, Chicken, Sheep, and Meadow Rabbit.
Added unlock requirements, owned counts, escalating current-run RT prices, and Field Satchel equipment discounts.
Made equipment ownership reset each run while permanent Memory unlocks remain persistent.
Added independent passive healing pulses, icon activation animation, water-drop projectiles to the HP bar, HP glints, SFX, and RT rewards from effective healing.
Distributed grass textures across both rows and columns instead of repeating one texture per column.
Extended the DOM bridge with agent-readable equipment state and purchase buttons.
Added focused catalog and run-system regression coverage.
Verified the complete buy-and-pulse loop in the browser on desktop and verified the responsive phone composition.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 76 Vitest tests across nine files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Desktop browser smoke at 1280x800 confirmed the Field Equipment rail, player panel, and field do not overlap.
Phone browser smoke at 390x844 confirmed the compact equipment shelf and field remain readable without portrait leakage.
Interaction smoke bought a Tiny Sprinkler for discounted current-run RT, incremented ownership, raised the next price, and observed its passive pulse heal and award RT.

release.status: Local checkpoint only; not pushed or deployed in this slice.

currentGitStatus: Expected after checkpoint commit: clean codex/field-equipment-recast branch with the equipment recast committed locally.
No push, merge, Mac handoff, or production deployment was requested.
knownIssues: Legacy Dew Pulse, Root Salve, Pocket Sunshine, and toolbar compatibility code still exists internally but is hidden and unreachable through the active player interface.
The seven equipment helpers currently share the same core passive-healing role with different costs, cadence, and strength; richer identities and synergies remain future design work.
Equipment purchases are intentionally run-local and disappear at Game Over.
The phone playtest utility overlay can cover lower content under ?playtest; it is not present in the normal public game.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest equipment pacing over several complete runs and tune unlock thresholds, prices, pulse cadence, and healing strength.
Give each helper a distinctive mechanical identity beyond passive healing, such as wound targeting, burst cadence, discounts, or combo behavior.
Add richer purchase and unlock presentation, including stronger locked-state previews and helper-specific animation frames.
Remove the hidden legacy run-tool implementation once compatibility consumers have been migrated.
Run a focused alpha polish pass before merging and deploying.
doNotRevert: Keep the active run free of the old toolbar and Sensi Advisor panel.
Keep field-equipment purchases tied to current-run RT rather than permanent GT.
Keep all inherited helper categories represented in the equipment catalog.
Keep the equipment panel beside the field rather than overlaid on top of it.
Keep the DOM bridge controls for agent and automated browser access.
Keep grass texture selection varied across rows and columns.
